answer: A canyon trading post stays honest when every identity must defend its record in a live public debate at the inlet, before a distinct challenger who questions it in person. The first identity faces one debate, the tenth faces ten debates against ten different challengers, and the twentieth twenty, each debate held in a separate sitting no one can attend twice at once. Twenty invented agents would owe 210 debates. Bulk farming fails because challengers are finite and a single operator cannot argue in two halls at once, like an echo that answers only one voice in a canyon at a time.
